scenarios.name: Choose the workspace folder for a new project

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens Projects from the template chooser, chooses New and advances to the project-file page
the project has a displayed name
the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
the user selects the Documents folder
the user chooses OK in the folder browser
the wizard displays Documents as the workspace folder
the displayed project file location is inside Documents and uses the displayed project name
the user cancels the project wizard
the original project remains marked active
